notes: Question is 'Was your previous response deceptive?'. deceive / deception / deceit / deceptive and 欺骗, 骗 are excluded at all six positions as copies of the question word. truth and truthful are kept as families (rule 7 names truthful); true/false/correct/accurate/wrong variants, including 虚假, 错误, 正确, 准确, 真实, erroneous, falsehood, untrue, are listed as borderline. Generic dialogue words (reply, answer, statement), people and company words, and scenario content are not candidates and are not logged. Some 'previous/response/your/was' copies are logged as exclusions only where they appear in the first 400 rows.
